description: Search CVEs by keyword, severity, CWE, publication or last-modified date, CISA KEV status, or the date CISA added a CVE to KEV. The primary discovery tool for vulnerability surveillance and triage workflows. pubDays, lastModDays, and kevDays expand to date pairs ending at call time; values over 120 days are clamped to the NVD maximum and reported in the response enrichment. A shorthand re-expands on every call, so page with the dates echoed in filtersApplied. Returns brief summaries — call nvd_get_cve for full detail on specific IDs. At least one filter is recommended; omitting all filters returns CVEs in default NVD index order (oldest first by CVE ID). Blank string filters are omitted with a notice; nonblank strings are trimmed.

exactPhrase.description: When true, keyword matches as an exact phrase rather than ANDing its words independently. Requires keyword.

kevDays.description: CVEs CISA added to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog in the last N days: expanded to kevStartDate/kevEndDate spanning exactly N × 24 hours up to call time (max 120; values over 120 are clamped). Returns only catalog members. Mutually exclusive with kevStartDate/kevEndDate. Each call re-expands it, so page with the dates echoed in filtersApplied.

kevEndDate.description: End of the KEV-addition window, in the same form as kevStartDate. Both kevStartDate and kevEndDate required together.

kevOnly.description: When true, filters results to CVEs in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, whenever CISA added them. A KEV window (kevDays or kevStartDate/kevEndDate) already returns only catalog members.

kevStartDate.description: Start of the window in which CISA added the CVE to the KEV catalog, as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.fraction]] with an optional Z or ±hh:mm offset, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; a value without an offset is read as UTC. Both kevStartDate and kevEndDate required together, at most 120 days apart. Returns only catalog members. Mutually exclusive with kevDays.

keyword.description: Full-text search across CVE descriptions (AND-semantics across words).

lastModDays.description: CVEs last modified in the last N days: expanded to lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate spanning exactly N × 24 hours up to call time (max 120; values over 120 are clamped). Mutually exclusive with lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate. Each call re-expands it, so page with the dates echoed in filtersApplied.

lastModEndDate.description: Last-modified range end, in the same form as lastModStartDate. Both lastModStartDate and lastModEndDate required together.

lastModStartDate.description: Last-modified range start, as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.fraction]] with an optional Z or ±hh:mm offset, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; a value without an offset is read as UTC. Both lastModStartDate and lastModEndDate required together, at most 120 days apart. Mutually exclusive with lastModDays.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20; values above 2000 are clamped unless NVD_CLAMP_LIMITS is false).

noRejected.description: When true (default), excludes CVEs with REJECT/Rejected status.

pubDays.description: CVEs published in the last N days: expanded to pubStartDate/pubEndDate spanning exactly N × 24 hours up to call time (max 120; values over 120 are clamped). Mutually exclusive with pubStartDate/pubEndDate. Each call re-expands it, so page with the dates echoed in filtersApplied.

pubEndDate.description: Publication range end, in the same form as pubStartDate. Both pubStartDate and pubEndDate required together.

pubStartDate.description: Publication range start, as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.fraction]] with an optional Z or ±hh:mm offset, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; a value without an offset is read as UTC. Both pubStartDate and pubEndDate required together, at most 120 days apart. Mutually exclusive with pubDays.

severity.description: Filter to CVEs in exactly this CVSS severity band — NVD matches the one band, not a floor. Covering several bands (e.g. HIGH and CRITICAL) takes one call per band.

severityVersion.description: CVSS version to use for the severity filter. Default: v3 (maps to cvssV3Severity).

name: nvd_search_cves

cves.description: Matching CVE summaries. Call nvd_get_cve for full detail on specific IDs.

items.description: Brief summary for one matching CVE.

cisaVulnerabilityName.description: CISA KEV vulnerability name. Present only when in the KEV catalog.

description.description: Opening 200 characters of the English CVE description, truncated with an ellipsis when longer. Enough to tell one result from another; call nvd_get_cve for the full text. Absent when NVD carries no description for the record.

filteredSeverity.description: Severity at the CVSS version the severity filter matched this CVE on. Present only when a severity filter was supplied and that version disagrees with the cross-version top severity above — e.g. a CVE scored v2 10.0 (HIGH) and v3.1 9.8 (CRITICAL) headlines as HIGH but matched a CRITICAL v3 query on the 9.8.

fromVersion.description: The CVSS version the severity filter matched on.

label.description: Severity label at the CVSS version the severity filter used.

score.description: Base score at that CVSS version (0.0–10.0).

severity.description: Top severity. Absent if no CVSS scores are present.

fromVersion.description: CVSS version this score came from.

label.description: Highest severity label across all CVSS versions.

datesClamped.description: Entries for any pubDays, lastModDays, or kevDays value that exceeded 120 and was clamped. Absent when no clamping occurred.

items.description: A single clamping event for one convenience date parameter.

param.description: The shorthand that was clamped (pubDays, lastModDays, or kevDays).

effectiveLimit.description: Page size or ID count used after clamping.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `nvd_invalid_response`: NVD returned an unusable response. `nvd_request_blocked`: The NVD security layer blocked the request. `nvd_request_rejected`: NVD rejected a search parameter. `exact_phrase_without_keyword`: exactPhrase was set without a keyword. It selects how keyword matches and has nothing to modify on its own; NVD rejects the underlying flag on the same grounds. `mutually_exclusive_params`: A date shorthand was sent with its explicit range: pubDays with pubStartDate/pubEndDate, lastModDays with lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate, or kevDays with kevStartDate/kevEndDate. `missing_date_pair`: Only one end of a date range was provided (pubStartDate/pubEndDate, lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate, or kevStartDate/kevEndDate) — NVD requires both. `date_range_inverted`: The end date of a date range is before its start date. `date_range_exceeds_max`: An explicit date range (pubStartDate/pubEndDate, lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate, or kevStartDate/kevEndDate) spans more than 120 days. `invalid_date_format`: A date field (pubStartDate, pubEndDate, lastModStartDate, lastModEndDate, kevStartDate, or kevEndDate) is not a date and time in the form NVD accepts. `invalid_severity_for_version`: severity="CRITICAL" was specified with severityVersion="v2" — CVSS v2 has no CRITICAL tier. `rate_limited`: NVD explicitly reported that the rate limit was exceeded. `nvd_unavailable`: NVD answered with HTTP 5xx, or the request or its response failed on the network, after the client retried. `nvd_timeout`: An NVD request outlived its timeout, or the call ran out of its 55-second deadline. `nvd_invalid_api_key`: NVD refused the server's configured NVD_API_KEY. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filtersApplied.description: The non-default filters this query actually applied — the ones that can account for an empty or unexpectedly narrow result set. Absent when the query ran unfiltered, which is itself the answer when a result set is unexpectedly broad.

cweId.description: The CWE weakness filter that was applied.

exactPhrase.description: Present as true when the keyword was matched as an exact phrase rather than word-by-word.

kevEndDate.description: Effective KEV-addition window end sent to NVD.

kevOnly.description: Present as true when results were limited to the CISA KEV catalog.

kevStartDate.description: Effective KEV-addition window start sent to NVD.

keyword.description: The keyword filter that was applied.

lastModEndDate.description: Effective last-modified range end sent to NVD.

lastModStartDate.description: Effective last-modified range start sent to NVD.

noRejected.description: Present as false when rejected CVEs were left in the results.

pubEndDate.description: Effective publication range end sent to NVD.

pubStartDate.description: Effective publication range start sent to NVD.

severity.description: The exact CVSS severity band that was applied — results are limited to this band alone, so higher bands are not included.

severityVersion.description: The CVSS version the severity filter matched on. Present only alongside severity.

notice.description: Ignored blank filters and paging guidance: distinguishes no matches, an exhausted offset, and an inconsistent empty upstream page; on a partial page, names the next offset and, on the first page of a window a shorthand set, the filtersApplied dates to send in its place; past offset 0, flags a shorthand window re-expanded for this call and points to the first page's dates instead.

offset.description: Page offset used in this query.

requestedLimit.description: Requested page size, or distinct ID count, before clamping.

returned.description: Number of CVEs returned in this response.

totalCount.description: Total matching CVEs in NVD before pagination.

title: Search CVEs
